Dear Marvellin Motorhandel,

As you instructed, the Bentley Continental GT (order CD-420322) remains stopped at the service area after the red warning light. Your roadside partner will collect the car from the service area at 12:00 today and take it to your Hamburg workshop.

Because the car cannot reach Hamburg today, the delivery window agreed for today, Wednesday 21 October 12:00–16:00 CEST, can no longer be met. We propose a new delivery window of Friday 23 October 12:00–16:00 CEST (10:00–14:00 UTC), after your workshop has attended to the car.

Please confirm whether this window works for you.

alternatives: Hold the promise change until the Hamburg workshop confirms it can attend to the car by Friday
Propose a later window if the workshop needs more time
